name: ctl
description: Manage intraday partitions and historical metadata indexes (dhctl).

commands.name: intraday
commands.description: Truncate, delete or rescan intraday partitions on the Data Import Servers.

commands.name: truncate
commands.description: truncate removes data at the specified partition(s) and disables further data ingestion.

options.description: print what actions would be performed without actually doing it
do not send requests to data import servers specified in an exclude parameter
send requests only to data import servers specified in an include parameter
specify a private key file to use for authentication
partition to act on (all internal partitions), as namespace.tableName.columnPartition
specify a file containing the base64 encoded password for the user that is set with --user
single partition to act on, as namespace.tableName.internalPartition.columnPartition
specify a user for authentication
print additional logging, progress messages, and full exception text

commands.name: delete
commands.description: delete completely removes the directories for the specified partition(s), clearing the way for new data to be ingested.

single partition to act on, as namespace.tableName.internalPartition.columnPartition

commands.name: rescan
commands.description: Have each Data Import Server rescan its intraday locations for new directories.

options.description: do not send requests to data import servers specified in an exclude parameter

commands.name: metadata
commands.description: List, validate or rebuild historical metadata indexes (.tlmi files).

commands.name: list
commands.description: Lists all of the metadata snapshots in the specified namespaces and tables.

options.description: A filter expression to select which column partitions to validate. The Partition column is always `Partition`
A file to write the list output to. Optional. Defaults to stdout
specify a private key file to use for authentication
The Column partition or partitions to validate.
specify a file containing the base64 encoded password for the user that is set with --user
The table or tables to act upon in Namespace.TableName or Namespace format. A wildcard '*' may be used to select all tables in all system namespaces.
specify a user for authentication
print additional logging, progress messages, and full exception text

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validates that each metadata snapshot present for the specified namespaces and tables matches the actual state present at each location and generates a report.

options.description: A filter expression to select which column partitions to validate. The Partition column is always `Partition`
specify a private key file to use for authentication

specify a file containing the base64 encoded password for the user that is set with --user
The table or tables to act upon in Namespace.TableName or Namespace format. A wildcard '*' may be used to select all tables in all system namespaces.
specify a user for authentication
print additional logging, progress messages, and full exception text
